isolated_probe_instance.notes: No wallet keys and no account address in the probe env, so the app own exchange fetch always fails ACCOUNT_ADDRESS_UNAVAILABLE. The app accepts an injected snapshot only while it is fresh (15s window) and rewrites it after that; each capture therefore writes the fixture, waits 3.2s for the 2s audit cache, reads /api/live-audit-summary and renders the DOM immediately. That the fixture was consumed (not the app rewrite) is proved by the captured values themselves: the API and the DOM both show the injected SENTORP 7.5 and the injected SENTSHARE totals 10 / 8 / 1, which cannot come from a failed fetch. A separate mode (fixture written, then left past the window) did flip to UNAVAILABLE, which is what established the 15s rewrite behaviour and is recorded here rather than hidden.

method.oracle: Two independent sides per row: (a) the /api/live-audit-summary JSON the renderer consumes, and (b) the rendered DOM read by headless Chromium (Playwright, py3.11) from #lcOrphanPositionRows. Neither side derives from the other.
method.mutation_control: Fixtures are injected in the exact schema the app itself writes (positions_by_coin -> signed_size / entry_px / mark_px / unrealized_pnl). Each value is unique across the row set and the same code path is re-run with the value changed, so a rendered string can only appear if it is bound to that row input.
method.fixture_schema_note: An earlier attempt used raw Hyperliquid clearinghouse keys (szi/markPx); the app overwrites snapshots it considers stale or off-schema, so raw keys are silently dropped. Every capture below uses the app-written schema and was verified to survive the rendering call.
method.cache_note: The app caches the audit summary for 2s in-process; each capture waits 3.2s and records cache_hit=false.

exact_mapping_demonstrated.rule_from_code: renderPositions() Context cell = engine_shortfall ? "exchange holds "+exchange_total_size+"; the leaders records add up to "+signed_size : (exchange_total_size != null ? "exchange holds "+exchange_total_size+"; leaders explain the rest" : "no engine order behind it"), and reconciliation_note goes verbatim into the cell title attribute.
verification: SENTORP: exchange_total_size null -> visible "no engine order behind it"; title equals the exact injected note "NO SERVICE ORDER EVIDENCE; not adopted into ledger".
SENTSHARE base: exchange_total_size 10 -> visible "exchange holds 10; leaders explain the rest"; title equals "aggregate shared-symbol residual; account-level only, never wallet-owned".
SENTSHARE total8: only the injected total changed 10 -> 8 -> visible becomes "exchange holds 8; leaders explain the rest".
SENTSHARE shortfall: total 1 < ledger net 5 -> engine_shortfall true -> visible "exchange holds 1; the leaders records add up to 5", the other branch of the same rule.

observed.why_pass: The register asks for reconciliation_note shown as a NO OWNED SLEEVE / explanation. The note is rendered verbatim as the Context cell title, and the visible text is a row-specific explanation proven to follow the app rule from injected inputs, with every branch exercised. The corrected artifact asserted PASS without supplying these values; this artifact supplies the exact injected note values and the exact mapping, which is what the reviewer required.
